name: android-traffic-control
description: Daemonless Android emulator and physical device leases, bounded-window warm-affinity wait queue, snapshots, and multi-agent guardrails around the official android CLI.
author: Sebastiano Poggi <me@sebastiano.dev>

scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async({readdirSync})=>{const{spawnSync}=await import('node:child_process');for(const d of['bin','src','test'])for(const f of readdirSync(d))if(f.endsWith('.mjs')){const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status)}})" && node --test
